## Public release on npm

`opencode-session-elapsed` is now published to the npm registry and installable directly from your OpenCode TUI config.

### Install

Add it to `~/.config/opencode/tui.json` and restart OpenCode:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/tui.json",
  "plugin": ["opencode-session-elapsed"]
}
```

Or install from source by pointing the plugin at `src/index.tsx` (see README).

### What's included

- **Session elapsed** timer — how long the current session has been open
- **Work time** timer — cumulative generation time across the session
- **Response time** timer — live while generating, then finalized
- Configurable slot, colors, icons, `compact`/`full` format, and refresh rate
- Safe to keep on: timers disappear automatically when there is nothing to show

### Links

- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-session-elapsed
- README: https://github.com/siriscmv/opencode-session-elapsed#readme
